Problem Statement:
Write a Java program that checks whether the given number is odd or even and if it is divisible by 7. The program should print "Yes" if the conditions are satisfied, otherwise print "No". 
Input Description:
The program should accept a single integer as input. 
Output Description:
The program should print "Yes" if the number is even and divisible by 7, or odd and divisible by 7.Otherwise, it should print "No". 
Sample Input:
14 
Sample Output:
Yes
